tasks.text: Approve the phased release boundaries, dashboard-first import UI, dashboard/mobile image/invoice/share coverage and representative pilot businesses. Native import UI and standalone screenshot/photo-to-record extraction remain explicit scope options.
Review the latest pricing matrix, one-business ownership, branches, trial, founding-price lock, core feature access and Enterprise treatment. Distinguish adoption from this consolidation.

Set Product-sharing/public-store access per plan or free launch policy; resolve its relationship to existing Store-owned Publish Site entitlement. Do not silently add a paywall or remove an accepted entitlement.

Choose free public-image reuse or the older paid-license marketplace. Recommended MVP: permitted free reuse, coins for AI. Amend ADR-0005 only after that choice is accepted; record the larger conditional paid branch in Phase 14.

Confirm business-owned coins across Stores, separate wallets across businesses, actor/Store attribution, staff spend limits, no initial transfers/cash-out and proposed no purchased-coin expiry. Decide whether import AI is included, budgeted for a pilot or separately charged.

Approve successful-deliverable AI charging, failure/rejection refunds, uncertain provider-result recovery, reference retention and fresh-variation pricing. Declining to apply a delivered image does not automatically refund generation.
Confirm one invoice per selected Order as default. Distinguish sales invoice, actual-payment receipt, internal spending voucher and an optional consolidated customer invoice.

Set eligible invoice sources/states, historical import cutoffs, role rules, file/row/sheet/image limits and retention. The source import plan proposes 30-day raw-original retention, with unresolved data/media copied durably before expiry; approve or revise that value. Pin outstanding decisions to the phase that needs them rather than guessing values.

Prove a minimal local apex routing spike for `/{businessSlug}` and `/{businessSlug}/{productSlug}`, assets, metadata and refresh; inventory reserved marketing/API/token paths and existing slug conflicts. Queue deployed Preview proof under its required environment authorization.

Inspect relevant Midday analogues and prepare file-level UI responsibilities before web implementation. Approve template/preset/batch starting assumptions: three invoice templates, six photo presets, one output and up to 50 Orders per batch are proposals to validate.
Define scoped actor/Tenant/Store authority, stable command identities, payload digests, revisions and retry results across all protected domains. Keep same-Tenant foreign keys explicit.

Define import runs/datasets/staging/commit receipts, bounded `meta` envelopes, retained-data locators, media/job relationships and proposed document identities. Choose minimal models/modules after inspecting existing work.

Assign extra data to Customer, shared Catalog Item, variant, Offering, Order or line correctly; overflow uses durable references, and unsupported sheets remain independent datasets. Original values/source coordinates are preserved before AI succeeds.

Use server-only private storage for import files/chunks, scoped Catalog assets and branding. Reuse the provider boundary while defining distinct ownership, retention and publication policies; bytes/base64 never enter `meta`.

Establish Trigger.dev conventions for bounded stages, identifier-only jobs, progress, cancellation, checkpoint recovery and reconciliation of uncertain external calls. Keep each domain's state machine and atomic receipt separate.

Introduce the smallest server AI boundary following the inspected GND structured-output pattern: configured provider/model, validated schemas, timeout/abort, bounded retries/repair and safe classified errors. Recheck supported versions before installing dependencies.

Define a versioned supported-import contract and template registry, mandatory/optional groups, relationships, compatibility adapters and processing modes. Templates derive from supported domain operations, not arbitrary Prisma columns.

Keep domain writes repository-owned and quote pricing server-owned; protect all reads/retries/commits against stale membership and Store context. Maintainer gap-log access is separate from merchant permissions.

Apply only approved additive Prisma changes using generated root development migrations, required `bun db:migrate --local` and `bun db:push --local`, plus client generation. Do not hand-author migrations or reset shared drift.

Prove tenant isolation, atomic graphs/receipts, raw-value recovery, storage expiry protection for unresolved data and provider-unavailable behavior. Update actual API/database contracts and approved ADRs as implementation lands.

Revalidate existing Catalog photo source/tests and provisioning status. Complete only missing provider setup/transport/verification and prove real upload → Item save → restart → refetch with owned fixtures.
Decode actual bytes, validate type/size/dimensions/resources, strip location metadata, normalize supported HEIC/HEIF and derive readable thumbnails. Conversion is distinct from content screening.
Support PNG/JPG/WebP logos and transparent backgrounds; require sanitization/controlled rasterization for SVG before accepting it. Keep PDF/exotic logo extraction a separately selected adapter.

Integrate a trusted exact-byte review verdict and protected preview/delivery. Pending/rejected bytes stay private; clients cannot grant approval, see storage credentials or obtain arbitrary provider URLs.

Define gallery promotion from an actor-private upload to a reusable business asset, explicit cross-Store permissions and many-Product associations. Do not broaden current attached/actor preview rights silently.

Add reviewed title/description/category/profile tags, origin/dimensions, ordering and lineage. Reuse current business-profile and approved category contracts; logos/private references are separate private media uses.
Build `My images` first in Gallery with search/filter/pagination, preview, choose, attach, replace/remove and gallery-only upload. Show a truthful Public images availability state until Phase 14.

Distinguish detachment from deletion, warn about other usages, preserve originals and implement safe orphan/expiry cleanup. Reconcile Tenant-deletion provider bytes; metadata cascade alone does not prove byte deletion.
Complete dashboard and mobile upload/camera/library flows, permissions, progress/cancel/reconnect and retained draft state. Verify both existing native appearances where affected.

Prove upload/save/reuse on a second authorized Product, unsafe-media refusal, foreign-scope denial, replacement/removal and cleanup with runtime/device evidence. Provider configuration failures must be actionable.

Build bounded CSV, TSV/delimited TXT, plain TXT and single-sheet XLSX parsing. Handle encoding/BOM/delimiters, multiline cells, duplicate headers, dates, leading zeros and missing/empty/zero/false distinctly.

Inventory all workbook sheets immediately, including hidden/unselected sheets, merged cells, totals and media. Preserve raw/formatted/cached formula values and coordinates; never execute formulas or fetch external links. PDF, Word, macro-enabled and encrypted workbook ingestion remain excluded unless separately added; XLS has its own Phase 10 proof gate.

Generate selectable Customer/Product/Service/Order CSV/XLSX samples from versioned contracts, including required dependencies, optional groups, allowed values, instructions and blank/synthetic examples. Never export actual business data as sample rows.

Put stable template versions/field IDs in Excel manifests or documented CSV columns; support exact unambiguous registry matching without markers. Separate CSV downloads represent multiple entities; one CSV has no workbook tabs.

Recognize actual compatible structure, reordered columns, omitted optional fields and reviewed old-version adapters. Reject required-field omissions, forged/unknown versions and ambiguous layout; markers/filenames grant no bypass.

Process compatible templates deterministically with zero AI calls, including background summaries. Retain extra custom columns; require an explicit AI-mapping choice for incompatible layouts rather than silently calling a provider.

For non-template input, use bounded AI to propose mapping, classification/transformations and uncertain text extraction against allowlisted domain contracts. Apply approved reusable rules deterministically across rows.

Stage all results and show original source, editable mapping, unknown-field disposition, duplicate decisions, required errors and create/update/skip/effect counts. Paginate large previews; confidence never replaces validation.
Build one URL-owned dashboard modal: Download sample / Upload → Detect or analyze → Review → Confirm → Progress/result, with feature-specific target and general mode prepared for Phase 10.

Persist/reopen review and progress; bind confirmation to source/mapping/schema/permission revisions and effects. Support cancellation, bounded retry and explicit partial results without preview domain writes.

Verify malicious/prompt-injection input, decompression limits, truncated output, ambiguous dates, missing formula caches and stale confirmation. Reconcile every field/record to mapped, retained, failed or explicitly skipped outcomes.

Prove generate/populate/upload/recognize/validate/confirm/refetch with a fail-if-called AI stub, provider outage, extra fields, removed/forged markers, old versions and malformed data. Any priced AI analysis uses the approved policy or an explicit controlled pilot budget until Phase 12 is accepted.
Deliver Customer Import first, with feature sample choices, template and AI paths, preview/commit/result/refetch and explicit supported create/update/skip behavior.

Resolve scoped source identities and normalized contacts; conflicting phone/email matches require review. Names alone never merge records. Implement supported update commands before advertising updates.
Preserve contact extras/provenance atomically and leave historical Order customer snapshots unchanged. Retain invalid/conflicting rows for correction.
Deliver Product imports for Items, variants, Offerings, units, prices/currency and selected Store. Review missing required configuration rather than fabricating it.

Keep imported Products unpublished/private drafts by default. Opening-stock effects require explicit supported Inventory commands/cutoffs and review; retain unsupported stock values inertly instead of applying them.
Deliver Services through the same Catalog engine, with their pricing/work policies. Catalog rows create no live jobs, appointments or Product inventory.
Persist extras on their correct Item/variant/Offering owners, enforce plan allowances using the adopted current authority, report every record and invalidate existing domain queries.
Prove atomic graph/meta/receipt commits, duplicate reuploads, interrupted retry and permission revocation for all adapters, including exact quantity/money/identity handling.

Accept Customers, then Products, then Services separately with configurable CSV/XLSX round trips, references, unsupported values, compatible-template zero-AI evidence and dashboard recovery/accessibility.

Define merchant document ownership separate from software `BillingInvoice`, allocate unique business invoice numbers separate from `ORD-*`, and retain source references plus idempotent issuance receipts.

Add business default branding/contact/address/payment instructions/terms and approved registration/tax fields, with only deliberate supported Store overrides. Upload/replace/remove logos through Phase 2 media.
Build a browsable template bank with realistic sample thumbnails/previews: proposed Minimal, Classic and Compact. Save default/template/accent preferences without altering issued documents.
Implement one server renderer/source contract for PDF and PNG. Templates cannot run merchant code or fetch arbitrary resources; fonts must render intended Unicode characters.

Snapshot seller/customer, line/unit/quantity, prices/currency/discounts/charges/taxes/totals, terms/due date and template/logo versions from eligible confirmed Order facts at issuance, using exact source arithmetic.

Define draft/issued/canceled/corrected and later payment-projection history. Retried issuance returns the original identity; re-download preserves issued amounts/branding and timestamped payment updates.

Add Order Generate invoice, preview and PDF/image download on dashboard, plus mobile save/share. Export does not collect payment, change stock, create new debt or post revenue. Automatic delivery is separate scope.
Handle no logo/customer, long names, many lines, unpaid/partial/paid states, zero-price lines and source cancellation. Multi-page PNG output is an ordered readable image set, never cropped silently.

Prove concurrency/replay, source/tenant identity, exact totals, pagination, Unicode/Yoruba text, unclipped images and actual browser/mobile downloads. Review jurisdictional invoice requirements before claiming tax compliance.
Add dashboard/mobile multi-Order selection and bulk Generate invoices, distinguishing selected rows from all-filtered selection and bounding batches explicitly.
Preview count, source eligibility/exclusions and output format. Do not silently omit Orders, duplicate them or merge unrelated customers.
Issue one invoice per Order through Phase 5 receipts; offer individual files, PDF/image ZIP and optionally one PDF containing separate invoices. This is not a consolidated debt/invoice.
Run bounded durable generation with progress, pre-start cancellation and close/reopen recovery; retain a manifest mapping each Order/document/file/result.
Preserve successful outputs on partial failure and retry failed items without new invoice numbers or unnecessary re-render of finished documents.
Reauthorize downloads, expire temporary grants and clean archives while retaining issued documents and audit history.
Verify ten-Order export, mixed eligibility, boundaries/multi-page images, repeated selection, permission revocation, disconnect and selective retry on dashboard/mobile.

Implement the proven apex dispatcher while preserving marketing/login/legal/API/assets and existing subdomain/token journeys. Resolve reserved slug conflicts non-destructively and freeze usable v1 business/Product slugs.
Bind one explicit public operating Store per business; do not pool prices, stock or WhatsApp contacts across branches. Explain and invalidate the public effect of switching it.

Add additive typed settings/listings with default-off browsing, separate Draft/Published consent, availability override, complete pause, revisions/audit and same-Tenant Store/Item FKs. Reuse existing entitlement ownership.

Implement authorized settings, publish/unpublish and availability commands with legal/safety/vertical/current-entitlement checks and exact retry identity. Internal ACTIVE/sales/imports/stock never publish automatically.

Keep browsing-off distinct from publication: store/grid/Visit store disappear while published Product pages stay available. Complete pause or Draft revokes Product access across page/API/metadata/images.
Build bounded anonymous Product/store/list DTOs with one effective publication predicate and allowlisted fields. No costs, suppliers, staff, raw stock, private files or draft counts/facets leak.

Resolve exact eligible Store/Offering prices and variant availability efficiently. Show price/range/Ask for price and Confirm availability where necessary; Unavailable dominates, Available cannot invent stock or bypass policy.

Reuse trusted text/media approval and approved derivatives; pending/private bytes remain inaccessible. Reconcile current Site/availability delivery gates with the new public-listing authority explicitly, without globally weakening the media boundary.

Start with authoritative dynamic/no-store eligibility reads, versioned derivative caches and purge. Validate the proposed maximum 60-second derivative staleness window and immediate new uncached refusal; do not promise recall of downloaded/third-party copies.

Prove protected role/FK/revision/replay/default-privacy invariants and anonymous denial through HTML, API, OG, images and filters. Check apex routes/assets/forwarding in authorized Preview as well as locally.
Build mobile-first Product detail with approved name/gallery/description, currency/prices, options and honest availability at `/{businessSlug}/{productSlug}`.

Build Ask on WhatsApp using server-resolved configured international contact and encoded Product/options/canonical-link draft. Never assume supportPhone is the correct recipient or use another branch's number.

Provide contact validation/test-link setup and missing-contact readiness errors; app/browser fallback and copied message support. A click is not a sent message, Order, Customer, reservation or integrated conversation.
Add Product-only Share to dashboard rows/details and mobile, with native/browser share, neutral cancellation and reliable Copy link fallback. Reader sharing never grants publish permission.

Show Draft readiness and explicit authorized Publish and share; separate public publication/availability from internal status and explain browse-off versus complete pause. Preserve retained editors, URL state, opener focus and mutation recovery.
Build `/{businessSlug}` and conditional Visit store with published-only cards, explicit browsing opt-in and privacy-safe empty/error states.
Add URL-backed search, accepted category facets, availability, stable name/price sort and bounded pagination. Handle unset/ranged prices and preserve grid filters/scroll across detail/back.
Generate safe canonical/OG metadata and eligible sitemaps/noindex rules. Browse-off Product URLs are public/guessable; noindex is not privacy and old external previews may persist.

Verify create/publish/share/inquire/unavailable/Draft/re-publish and browsing on/off on merchant dashboard/mobile and anonymous Android/iOS browser/desktop, with Unicode encoding and no-WhatsApp/error cases. Sending a test message requires explicit human authorization.
Record bounded generic view/share/copy/CTA events without contact/message content. Verify real social previews and usability; do not count a WhatsApp click as a completed sale or message.

Approve historical versus newly actionable Orders: original dates/reference facts, internal numbering, cutoffs/report inclusion and affected stock/Finance/Service policy. Inventory accepted upstream source capabilities before exposing effects.
Group source rows into stable Orders, resolve scoped Customer/Offering dependencies and flag missing/ambiguous references; never fabricate matches or current inventory history.
Preserve immutable historical customer/line/Offering snapshots and source references while allocating internal Order identity using the existing numbering authority.
Recompute/compare exact amounts and reject discrepant totals, ambiguous currencies/taxes/discounts or invalid quantities for the affected Order.
Define explicit source-backed payment/refund/outstanding balance/fulfillment/Service treatment. A paid/completed label alone cannot establish provider success, work performance or stock provenance.
Prevent double counting against opening stock, opening customer debt, cash receipts and journals. Confirmation lists every effect; imported history sends no automatic reminder/message.
Implement an atomic Order/line/snapshot/meta/receipt adapter with only supported source-effect commands. Retain incomplete/evidence-unsupported Orders with actionable errors.
Generate Order CSV/XLSX samples with grouping/dependencies/dates/allowed financial fields, retaining all historical-policy gates even when templates bypass AI.
Prove mixed Product/Service, partially paid, historical and rejected fixtures; reconcile Orders, stock, Service work and balances with source facts and demonstrate retry without double effects.
Add the global Import entry using the same modal/engine, visible business scope and reviewed Store assignments. Classify every sheet as supported entity or retained unsupported data.
Plan deterministic dependencies: Customers/Catalog prerequisites before Orders, cross-sheet stable references, cycles/missing/duplicate identities and dependent failure behavior.
Review all mapping/relationship/Store/effect/retention decisions in one versioned plan. Generate selected related XLSX samples or separate CSV datasets, with compatible-template zero-AI execution.
Use bounded parse/normalize/validate/commit stages, private chunks and per-record receipts. Resume process/worker failure; cancellation preserves already committed results and blocks later units.
Provide completed/failed/skipped/retained results, blocked-dependent Orders and explicit corrected-plan retries. Never put the whole workbook into one transaction or AI prompt.
Implement fixture-proved legacy XLS parsing/normalization before advertising it. Explicitly retain/report unsupported legacy media and conversion requirements.

Extract bounded XLSX embedded bytes/drawing anchors and inventory unsupported in-cell/linked/spanning/background/chart cases. Retain durable manifests so media does not disappear when original files expire.
Preview image-to-record associations, resolve ambiguous anchors and allow multiple/shared photos or explicitly attached Product photos. Do not fetch arbitrary image URLs.

Commit photos through Phase 2 checks/assets/receipts and atomic Item association, respecting the current eight-photo limit unless deliberately revised. Retain/report overflow; photo storage alone needs no AI interpretation.

Prove mixed four-entity plus unknown-sheet workbooks, large tested limits/runtime/memory/AI cost, interruptions and multiple/shared/ambiguous images. Refetch saved photos and reconcile every source field/row/media item.

Revalidate price/fee/policy assumptions against primary sources and measured costs. Adopt a versioned regional matrix or record an explicit revision; tax wording and actual payable amounts need concrete launch validation.

Reconcile existing “business/store” counters with one subscription per business and the proposed branch/staff/active-Item/device definitions. Define trial, plan transitions and founding-price renewal lock; preserve existing records on downgrade.

Make core operations, ordinary invoices and record/history/export access consistent with the adopted promise. Define advanced reporting/scale/support differences, fair limits and distinct variable-cost charges; no hidden legacy history cap contradicts the new offer.

Implement server-authoritative versioned entitlements and quota enforcement in ordinary writes, imports, invites/device registration and Store creation, with accurate client usage and limit-resolution guidance.

Implement public-share/browse/Publish Site plan rules from Phase 0. Reconcile the accepted software state and effective public eligibility without introducing coin-gated publishing or accidental stock/POS changes.
Configure verified provider-neutral web checkout, subscription purchases/renewals/failures/cancellation/refunds and idempotent event/reconciliation. Client payment callbacks alone grant no access.

Show monthly/quarterly/annual payable prices, trial end, renewal and fees, separate software billing receipts/invoices, plan management and Enterprise contact. No automatic sales commission; variable charges are disclosed separately.

Test renewal/replay/late events, competing upgrades, downgrade above limits, trial expiry, offline bridge consistency and suspended-provider recovery with owned accounts. Define a record-preserving grace/read/export policy before implementation.

Keep first-release native paid checkout deferred. If later approved, restore native configuration deliberately and verify exact products, receipts/notifications/restore/refunds and signed Android/iOS artifacts under current regional rules.

Run the proposed 90-day paid pilot, measuring conversion, retention, limit hits, support time, infra/provider/native fees and failure reasons. Repricing follows evidence and founding-price promises, with explicit renewal communications policy.

Implement the immutable business coin ledger: verified purchases, holds, settled debits, releases/refunds and audited adjustments; derive available/held balances with Store/actor attribution. Keep merchant cash and subscription accounting separate.
Select coin pack/action prices after measured provider/storage/failure/refund/payment costs and target margin. Show balance/history, actual payable pack price/status and purchase receipts.

Credit only server-verified payment transactions bound to the business wallet. Deduplicate callbacks/events/reconciliation and handle refunds/chargebacks after spending under an explicit operational policy.

Quote each paid action by operation, input digest, model/quality/output count and expiry; show price, post-spend balance and insufficient funds before confirmation. Import/summary charges require their own agreed rules; template imports remain zero-AI.
Atomically reserve before enqueueing an idempotent job. Enforce staff permissions/caps and simultaneous-last-coins invariants; clients cannot choose free prices or another business wallet.

Keep external calls outside database transitions. Reconcile timeout/uncertain provider results before rerun or release; cancellation cannot free coins while the same call can still deliver and settle.
Save/verify/check deliverable assets before settling once. Link job/asset/receipt/ledger durably; release failed/rejected/undeliverable holds and retain audit history for operational refunds.
Add budgets/rate limits, stuck-hold inspection, provider cost/usage records and a global pause with private prompts/images excluded from diagnostics.

Prove duplicate top-ups, concurrent spend, crash-after-provider-success, storage failure, rejected result, cancel/restart and chargeback recovery. Paid web acceptance and native acceptance are separate.

Enable native top-ups/consumption only after the separately approved product/policy/verifier/refund release; no assumption that web-bought coins or checkout links are permitted in every native market.
Add Refine with AI to eligible owned/licensed photos, with a prerequisite if no usable image exists. Check source/reference rights and allowed business/vertical eligibility.
Deliver Preset samples, Upload a reference and Surprise me. Use reviewed category-relevant styles; record preset/reference/seed where supported, limits and retention.
Preserve Product identity, packaging/labels, colors, quantities and salient features. Surprise me changes photography presentation; quality review rejects misleading substitutions.
Show source/mode/quality/output count and exact Phase 12 quote, then resumable pending/result state across close/reopen or Store switching.
Save checked outputs as private gallery assets with original/source/reference/preset/job lineage. Preserve the original and use the same media lifecycle as ordinary uploads.
Offer before/after, Use image, Keep in gallery and a newly quoted variation. Explicitly replace only the selected Product attachment; delivered-but-unused work follows the approved charge policy.

Refine logos with spelling/symbol-preservation and cleanup/clarity/transparent-output options. Preview against invoice templates, keep both versions privately and avoid promising vector output or rewritten-text accuracy.

Accept refined branding only for future documents; issued invoices remain unchanged. References/logos do not enter the public directory automatically and ordinary invoice generation consumes no coins.

Verify all modes, low balance, reference misuse, exact Product/Store attachment, logo text, failed review/recovery and both supported merchant surfaces; measure usable output and actual cost before approving prices for broader release.
Add a distinct Make public action with approved-image/metadata preview, permitted reuse terms and rights confirmation. Product publication alone does not offer the underlying photo for reuse.
Publish only approved image/title/description/category/use tags; never enrich from private notes, customers, prices, references, branding or Service/Prescription evidence.

Add Public images second in Gallery with paginated title/description/category/Product-use search, profile-relevant defaults and broadenable filters. Reuse the existing business profiles rather than split Catalog schemas.
Let merchants review suggested use tags, maintain/de-index changes and prevent another business attachment from leaking its private description into search.
Copy or grant the accepted reuse license into the selecting business gallery before attachment, retaining source lineage. Discovery, reuse and Product attachment have separate rights checks.

If free reuse is adopted, document permitted use/no seller payout. If paid reuse is retained instead, first implement price/license identity, purchase holds, settlements/payouts, refunds/reversals/disputes, seller permissions and audited reconciliation; do not mark that branch accepted without its evidence.
Prevent unsupported republication of licensed/refined derivatives and circular ownership claims. Record any accepted amendment to older marketplace contracts.
Implement unpublish/report/block/moderator/dispute queues and cache/search invalidation. Define prior permitted-copy handling versus rights/policy takedown requiring intervention.
Seed permissioned reviewed imagery and prove relevance, private-field isolation, reuse, unpublish/removal, direct download gating and takedown effects on referenced copies.

Inventory accepted expense/purchase/payment/refund and relevant Service/booking sources. Reuse Commercial Order output where it already covers the sale; preserve owning Finance roles and source/correction/cutoff facts.

Add truthful typed adapters for spending vouchers, supplier bills/purchases and actual-payment/refund receipts. Distinguish internal output from supplier-issued original invoices; store originals privately.
Reuse branding/templates/PDF/image/batch delivery with source-specific currency/date/balance/privacy and correction status. Add document actions to the owning detail/list views.

If selected, define consolidated customer invoices only across compatible business/seller/customer/currency and exact unpaid balances/Order references. A combined PDF of separate invoices remains Phase 6.
Define per-Order/consolidated invoice coverage and corrections to prevent double billing. Document presentation creates no debt, revenue, stock movement or payment allocation.
Verify amounts/source identity, original-receipt privacy, denied foreign reads, refunds/corrections and unchanged financial state on single/selected-record exports.
Populate canonical gap logs from retained fields/unsupported datasets, grouping signatures/counts while keeping every exact source locator and disposition.

Add optional typed AI summaries identifying unsupported concepts/structures, existing feature fit, ambiguities and source-backed proposed work. Cite retained paths; prohibit SQL/runtime commands and fabricated facts.
Keep compatible-template logs factual with zero automatic AI calls. Any later AI gap analysis is a separately explicit action subject to its approved cost/privacy policy.

Build a minimal authorized internal review view with awaiting/accepted/deferred/resolved states and decision links. Mask/synthesize examples for developers/logs; raw business data requires separate scoped support access.

Optionally prepare sanitized GitHub issue drafts and authenticated internal links. Configure destination only if selected; human review and explicit publish authorization are required, with deduplication/uncertain-result recovery. No issue is posted by this planning task.

For each actually shipped feature, define a versioned deterministic promotion rule: eligible target/source digest/path, conversion/destination/validation/conflicts/effects. Adding a column alone triggers no guessed migration.
Dry-run promotable/ambiguous/invalid/conflicting counts and obtain review of the exact feature rule and rollout scope; keep merchant edits and current destination values authoritative.

Run approved feature-release promotion through bounded jobs with receipts/checkpoints, revision rechecks and atomic destination/provenance changes. Archive the original and mark promoted only on success.
Retain unresolved remainder under the adopted retention policy, update gap counts and prove interruption/retry/competing-edit/rule-upgrade behavior; corrections use the domain's own rules.
Assemble one evidence matrix across applicable phases, source revisions and release environments. Every task/phase requires its actual gate, not merely implementation or inherited mock results.

Run the full format/entity/template corpus: CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS, contacts with leading zeros/conflicts, Products/Services with extras, mixed partial/historical Orders, four-entity plus unknown sheets and media accounting.
Prove configurable blank/example sample round trips, version/marker/column changes and provider-outage zero-AI behavior; promotion fixtures include empty/invalid/conflicting destinations.

Verify tenant/Store/actor denial, revoked membership, stale confirmations, malicious/oversized input, exact-money/stock/work invariants and private/public byte isolation. Verify only supported effects with current Finance sources.

Complete desktop/narrow browser and physical Android/iOS evidence for applicable merchant/customer surfaces, keyboard/screen reader, light/dark themes, large text, share/camera permissions and opener/scroll retention. Dashboard-only imports do not imply native import coverage.

Exercise slow networks, close/reopen, process restart, uncertain commits/payments/provider results, download failures and refund/cancellation/retry. Reconcile all records/fields/media/documents/coins to accountable outcomes.

Operate reference-based support lookup, stuck-job/hold inspection, audits/refunds/moderation, cleanup/retention and independent pause/rollback switches that preserve existing records, documents and assets.

Measure import/export success/latency, usable AI output, provider cost versus revenue, refunds/stuck holds, storage growth, public reports and subscription conversion/retention/support load. Set thresholds from measured pilot baselines, not invented percentages.

Update actual feature/API/endpoints/permissions/schema/relationships/migrations/ADR/task docs with implemented limits and observed acceptance; retain source proposal history and this master checklist's links.

Review concrete acceptance packets with the owner, clean run-owned fixtures and pilot selected ordinary businesses under flags. Record each narrower slice explicitly; full scope stays open until all mandatory selected branches pass.

Apply Preview/Production migrations, provider configuration, routing/jobs deployments and flags only under separately authorized targets and existing signed release assurance. Validate correct credentials/identities per environment; development evidence is not production proof.

Verify post-release readiness and rollback using the existing operations process, record actual release/acceptance and monitor the approved paid pilot. Future scheduled monitoring needs its own explicit request and configured automation.
